annotations.title: Plan a rules-checked East End day

description: Three distinct, ordered East End day plans built by Hamptons Verified's deterministic planner, the same rules engine as the website. Each plan is a time-ordered list of stops with `time`, `block`, `name`, `town`, `reason`, `source`, the guide's own listing `url`, and a `mapsUrl` directions link. Before a plan is returned the planner applies permanent closures, the selected date's opening hours, age fit, budget, weather, daylight, geographic sequencing and the maximum drive between consecutive stops. A stop that is a dated event carries an `event` object: its `time` is the organiser's published start, with `access`, `accessNote`, `ticketing`, `source`, `sourceUrl` and `lastVerified`. `eventsOnThisDateNotInThePlan` lists events the guide holds for that date and scope that were not used, each with `whyNotInThePlan`. `saved_places` is a preference lane: names supplied by the asker are worked in where eligible and never override a closure, hours, travel or safety rule; the tool has no access to any account, browser or saved list. The answer reports `vibesUnderstood`, `vibesNotUnderstood`, `whoReadAs` and `partySize`, and a stop whose operator publishes a maximum party size below `party_size` carries a `capacityWarning` quoting the operator's line. `townScope` reports how the place argument was read; `townScope.recognized: false` means the name matched no East End place, the rows array is empty, and `didYouMean` lists near matches where any exist.

date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) in East End local time; defaults to today.

party_size.description: Number of people, as digits. Stops whose operator publishes a maximum below this number carry a `capacityWarning` quoting the operator's line. When omitted, no capacity check is made.

saved_places.description: Comma-separated venue names the asker wants included, used as preferences only.

seed.description: Optional stable seed; the same seed and inputs reproduce the same plans.

town.description: A hamlet or region to keep the day around. Omit for the full East End.

vibes.description: Comma-separated interests from: quiet, active, foodie, cultural, beach, adventure, romantic, off-season, shopping, anything. Values outside this list do not influence the plan and are reported in `vibesNotUnderstood`.

who.description: Who the day is for: solo, couple, family, friends, first-date, in-laws. There is no 'group' value: a group of friends is `friends`, a group with children is `family`, and common aliases are resolved to the nearest value, which the answer reports in `whoReadAs`. Group size is `party_size`.
